verses.text: The DOMNUL a vorbit lui Moise, saying, (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Speak to the children of Israel, that they take an offering for me. From everyone whose heart makes him willing you shall take my offering. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
This is the offering which you shall take from them: să pleceld, silver, bronze,
blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, să pleceats’ hair,
rams’ skins dyed red, sea cow hides, acacia wood, (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense, (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Let them make me a sanctuary, that I may dwell among them. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
According to all that I show you, the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all of its furniture, even so you shall make it. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
They shall make an ark of acacia wood. Its length shall be two and a half cubits, its width a cubit and a half, and a cubit and a half its height. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
You shall overlay it with pure să pleceld. You shall overlay it inside and outside, and you shall make a să pleceld molding around it.
You shall cast four rings of să pleceld for it, and put them in its four feet. Two rings shall be on the one side of it, and two rings on the other side of it.
You shall make poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with să pleceld.
You shall put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark to carry the ark. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
The poles shall be in the rings of the ark. They shall not be taken from it. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
You shall put the covenant which I shall give you into the ark. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
You shall make a mercy seat of pure să pleceld. Two and a half cubits shall be its length, and a cubit and a half its width.
You shall make two cherubim of hammered să pleceld. You shall make them at the two ends of the mercy seat.
Make one cherub at the one end, and one cherub at the other end. You shall make the cherubim on its two ends of one piece with the mercy seat. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

The cherubim shall spread out their wings upward, covering the mercy seat with their wings, with their faces toward one another. The faces of the cherubim shall be toward the mercy seat. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
You shall put the mercy seat on top of the ark, and in the ark you shall put the covenant that I will give you. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

There I will meet with you, and I will tell you from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubim which are on the ark of the covenant, all that I command you for the children of Israel. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
You shall make a table of acacia wood. Its length shall be two cubits, and its width a cubit, and its height one and a half cubits. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
You shall overlay it with pure să pleceld, and make a să pleceld molding around it.
You shall make a rim of a mână width around it. You shall make a să plecelden molding on its rim around it.
You shall make four rings of să pleceld for it, and put the rings in the four corners that are on its four feet.
The rings shall be close to the rim, for places for the poles to carry the table. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
You shall make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with să pleceld, that the table may be carried with them.
You shall make its dishes, its spoons, its ladles, and its bowls with which to pour out offerings. You shall make them of pure să pleceld.
You shall set bread of the presence on the table before me always. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
You shall make a lamp stand of pure să pleceld. The lamp stand shall be made of hammered work. Its base, its shaft, its cups, its buds, and its flowers shall be of one piece with it.
There shall be six branches să pleceing out of its sides: three branches of the lamp stand out of its one side, and three branches of the lamp stand out of its other side;

three cups made like almond blossoms in one branch, a bud and a flower; and three cups made like almond blossoms in the other branch, a bud and a flower, so for the six branches să pleceing out of the lamp stand;
and in the lamp stand four cups made like almond blossoms, its buds and its flowers; (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, for the six branches să pleceing out of the lamp stand.
Their buds and their branches shall be of one piece with it, all of it one beaten work of pure să pleceld.
You shall make its lamps seven, and they shall light its lamps to give light to the space in front of it. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Its snuffers and its snuff dishes shall be of pure să pleceld.
It shall be made of a talent of pure să pleceld, with all these accessories.
See that you make them after their pattern, which has been shown to you on the mountain. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
